**Coaching note:**

Look for checks that fork the king and weak pieces. Here, Nc7+ forces Black's king to d8, leaving the rook on a8 undefended. After Qxc4, White has won the bishop and maintains a strong initiative, even after Black's in-between check Nf3+. When you're up material and have a dominant position, calculate forcing moves—especially checks that pull the enemy king to worse squares where more pieces hang.
